description: Read your messages and your mentions (channel posts that name you as @<your-name>), oldest first, one page at a time (default 50, max 200). A message has id (its own), inReplyTo (the id of the message it answers, or null), from, sentAt, body and broadcast; to answer a message, call send_message with in_reply_to set to its id, so that an ask waiting for the answer sees it. A mention has channel, id (the post's), from, sentAt and body. By default only unread ones; everything returned is marked read, so a full page means there may be more: call again. With unread_only false, use offset to page through history. To be woken when mail arrives instead of polling, run the wait command that register returns in the background; when it fires, call read_inbox if it names messages or mentions and read_channel for each channel it names posts in, and only then start it again. Requires register first.
name: read_inbox
